description:
About GameChanger:

We believe in the life-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.

So if you love sports and their community-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

The Position:

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will shape the technical vision and lead the delivery of integrations and APIs built and operated as products. Your initial focus will be the Partner API: turning GameChanger’s capabilities and domain expertise into secure, reliable, scalable, and intuitive experiences that external developers and partners can build on with confidence. Over time, your impact will extend across product lines and the broader engineering organization as you help establish durable technical direction and raise the standard for backend and API engineering.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a hands-off architecture position. You will work directly with engineers to design, build, launch, and operate integrations and APIs, making consequential architectural decisions and contributing to critical implementation work. You will bring deep experience building developer-facing products and guide decisions across API contracts, authentication and authorization, versioning, documentation, observability, reliability, support, and developer experience.

You will connect immediate product delivery to GameChanger’s longer-term architecture and business strategy. Working with engineering and product leaders, service owners, and business partners, you will align teams around a shared technical direction, address cross-system risks and dependencies, and establish reusable patterns and operational standards. You will mentor engineers and technical leaders across specialties, grow backend and integration expertise, and help teams make and execute sound decisions. This role will report to an Engineering Director.

What You’ll Do:

  • Shape the technical vision and roadmap for integrations and API products, initially leading the design and delivery of the Partner API in partnership with Engineering and Product leaders.

  • Work hands-on with engineers to design, build, launch, and operate these products, owning critical implementation work and balancing near-term partner learning with a durable long-term foundation.

  • Establish and scale standards and reusable patterns for API contracts, authentication and authorization, versioning, rate limiting, error handling, webhooks, documentation, and developer experience.

  • Lead and review system designs across GameChanger services and external systems, aligning architecture with broader organizational goals and addressing dependencies, failure modes, and tradeoffs involving performance, security, reliability, maintainability, cost, and future use cases.

  • Partner with engineering leadership and service owners to establish production support, reliability, observability, and incident-management practices, including shared SLIs, SLOs, and service-health metrics that span systems and teams.

  • Identify strategic risks to the long-term health, scalability, and resilience of systems, secure support for practical improvements, and drive investments in testing, incident prevention, and remediation.

  • Partner with Product and business leaders to clarify partner needs, shape product and technical priorities, and connect investments and outcomes to company strategy.

  • Serve as a technical bridge across teams responsible for backend services, infrastructure, data, and client applications, helping each understand how its work contributes to a cohesive integration and developer experience.

  • Evaluate build, buy, and integration options, clearly communicating tradeoffs and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders and driving decisions to clear outcomes.

  • Establish and improve lightweight, scalable practices for design reviews, technical proposals, API lifecycle decisions, and documenting architectural tradeoffs across teams.

  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, including Staff and senior engineers, and raise the technical bar across the organization through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and reusable guidance.

  • Identify organizational skill gaps and help build lasting backend, integration, and technical leadership capabilities through mentorship, learning forums, and other practical development efforts.

  • Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, and business functions; surface disagreement and ambiguity early and align stakeholders around shared goals.

  • Participate in an occasional on-call rotation and model strong ownership of production systems.

Who You Are

  • You are a hands-on technical leader who connects business and product goals to technical vision and architecture, breaks complex initiatives into deliverable milestones, and works through implementation details.

  • You have strong product judgment and understand that successful integrations and API products include contracts, documentation, developer workflows, operations, and support—not only endpoints.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of an ambiguous, high-impact space, clarifying the most important problems, and creating a path forward without detailed direction.

  • You decompose complex, company-wide problems, clarify dependencies and ownership across teams, and help teams understand how their contributions support a shared outcome.

  • You reason clearly about tradeoffs and design systems for both immediate needs and plausible future use cases, recognizing risks to long-term system health.

  • You build trust with engineers and senior leaders across technical, product, and business functions, adapt your communication to your audience, and create clarity and alignment across departments.

  • You lead through influence, direct contribution, and follow-through, and you take accountability for outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

  • You invest in engineers and technical leaders and create reusable guidance, tools, and practices that raise quality and decision-making across the organization.

Experience

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on technical leadership on complex, business-critical systems.

  • Demonstrated experience building, launching, and operating integrations or developer-facing APIs as products, including supporting external consumers over time.

  • Deep knowledge of API design and lifecycle management, including authentication and authorization, versioning, backwards compatibility, rate limiting, documentation, and developer experience.

  • Experience designing and evolving distributed, high-scale production systems with strong security, reliability, observability, and performance characteristics.

  • Experience shaping technical vision and architecture across multiple teams, systems, or product areas, and leading substantial initiatives from problem definition through production operation.

  • Experience establishing production-readiness standards, shared service-health metrics, and incident practices, and driving longer-term investments in reliability and resilience across teams.

  • A track record of aligning engineering, product, and business leaders, resolving cross-team ambiguity, and connecting technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Experience mentoring senior and Staff engineers or other technical leaders, identifying capability gaps, and improving engineering practices across an organization.

  • Experience working with third-party developers, strategic partners, API consumers, or platform ecosystems is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, Redis, and PostgreSQL is preferred.

Perks:

  • Work remotely throughout the US* or from our well-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY.

  • Unlimited vacation policy.

  • Paid volunteer opportunities.

  • Technology stipend - $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology.

  • WFH stipend - $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable.

  • Monthly physical, mental, wellness & learning stipend offered through Holisticly.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe.

  • Full health benefits - medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents.

  • Retirement savings - Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match.

  • Life insurance - basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life.

  • Disability leave - short-term disability and long-term disability.

  • Company paid parental leave - up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.

  • Family building benefits offered through Progyny.

  • DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount.

The target salary range for this position is between $210,000 and $230,000. This is part of a total compensation package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by several factors including experience, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We constantly review all teammate pay to ensure a great compensation package that is fair and equal across the board.

* DICK'S Sporting Goods has company-wide practices to monitor and protect the company from significant compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our Interview Process & AI

We recognize that AI has become a common part of everyday life and professional work, and its use continues to evolve rapidly. Our perspective on AI in the hiring process will evolve as well. At this time, we ask that candidates please refrain from using AI tools during interviews and assessments, as we want to see your authentic self. We will clearly indicate if and when AI use is acceptable in the process. If you have any questions or need accommodations, we're here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

IMPORTANT NOTICE: All official recruitment communications from GameChanger will come from an email address ending in @gc.com or no-reply@ashby.hq.com. If you receive communication from any other domain, please be cautious, as it is likely fraudulent.
